Class AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
Direct Known Subclasses:
KeyDisplayValueSwingModel.Remodel, SimpleComboListSwingModel.Remodel
Enclosing class:
AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel
protected abstract class AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel extends Object implements AutoCloseable
This provides methods to perform inspections and modification of XxxListInfo. It is anticipated that subclass may want to use Remodel as part of a locking scheme for multi-threaded access to AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel. The verifyOpened() method is useful for that. Typically methods in a subclass invoke super.someMethod which does verifyOpened(). If a method in a subclass directly modifies the item list or its contents it should call verifyOpened as its first statement; this avoids modifications after the lock is released.

This pattern should be used when working with the list to guarantee exclusive access. It avoids many potential synchronization problems. 

    try (Model.remodel remodel = keyVis.getRemodel()) {
        // ...
    }
When there is no locking, getRemodel() is fast; there is minimal overhead.

See GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo for example of Remodel locking

Since:
4.0.0
